N.accepted_runtime_ceiling_seconds: root-accepted budget at least group timeout_seconds + 60 seconds
N.deadline_unix: root-authorized deadline; both now + accepted ceiling and now + fixed subprocess timeout plus 60-second grace must be <= deadline

between_group_gate.prior_completion: completed, child and driver exit 0, outputs validated and hash-bound
between_group_gate.forecast_miss: requires forecast-miss-accepted-group-N.json with root signature fields and hashes bound to completion and admission
between_group_gate.group_review: must explicitly authorize the next group; driver never advances automatically

recording.launch: exclusive launch-group-NN.json immediately before child invocation
recording.terminal: exclusive completion-group-NN.json on every execution-path error after invocation request

runtime_timeout.policy: No automatic run truncation based on accepted ceiling; refuse launch unless accepted ceiling and remaining deadline cover the frozen child timeout plus 60-second subprocess grace.

output_validation: exact source case path and case SHA-256
requested generation cap equals original group cap
generated IDs and count agree and do not exceed cap
execution_policy: The inference runner is invoked only inside --execute --group N after all checks and an actual root admission. Validation and tests do not import TTNN, touch devices, load the model, or invoke the HF runner.
volatile_predecessor_note: The frozen progress snapshot hash remains in source-integrity.json but is not compared to its mutable live file; final HF9 completion must be independently pinned by root in predecessor-gate.json.
root_roster_review: Required static root review verifies all20 seed-specific source/fixture hashes and exact proposal/forecast pins; review status does not authorize execution.
